title: Modernize core token set and compact component rhythm
creator: Asha Menon
description: Rationalize and modernize the design token surface to support a fluid typography scale, compact spacing rhythm, simplified color lanes for improved contrast, and a clearer elevation/shadow hierarchy for tables and charts. This ticket covers token definitions, alias mappings, component updates (buttons, tables, charts), migration guide for engineering, and accessibility validation for AA/AAA where feasible.
background: Our current token set grew organically and contains duplicate semantics, inconsistent spacing multiples across components, and an elevation system that doesn’t map well to dense (compact) surfaces like tables and small cards. Recent product needs require a compact mode for embedded widgets and chart overlays, and mobile-first responsive type that scales fluidly across breakpoints. This work reduces token surface area while providing explicit aliases for backwards compatibility.
goals: Define a single truth token file with semantic tokens for background, surface, border, accent, and text roles
Introduce a fluid type scale (clamped REM values) and map tokens to component-level sizes
Establish a consistent spacing/radius scale with explicit compact variants
Redesign elevation/shadow tokens into three semantic levels: none, raised, overlay with density-specific variants
Provide alias mapping and automated codemod guidance to minimize engineering churn
Validate color lanes for contrast (AA for body text, AA/AAA for large text) across primary product themes
acceptance_criteria: Master token JSON/YAML published in repo root and consumed by storybook tokens source
Component snapshots (buttons, tables, chart tooltips) updated and visual diffs approved
Migration guide + codemod PR merged and smoke-tested by one platform team
Accessibility report showing contrast ratios for all text role tokens across three core palettes
Performance: no perceptible regression in bundle size (+/- 1%) from token churn
design_notes: Prefer semantic token names (e.g., surface-default, surface-compact, text-primary, text-secondary) over raw color references. Use CSS clamp() pattern for fluid typography with min/ideal/max rems. Spacing should use a 4px base grid with explicit compact multiples (e.g., spacing-2-compact). Elevation should be expressed as token aliases to shadow presets so runtime can swap depth behavior for platform-specific engines.
tradeoffs: Keep alias layer for backward compatibility vs. aggressive consolidation that reduces cognitive load
Three-level elevation simplifies decisions but may not capture subtle depth used in legacy components
Fluid type increases runtime CSS complexity but improves cross-device rhythm and reduces breakpoint patching

Coordinate with platform teams to test release candidate in staging environment
Roll out tokens package as canary to low-traffic services, then full rollout after 1 week of smoke tests
testing_plan: Visual regression: baseline snapshots for all primary components in default and compact densities
Automated contrast tests for all text tokens across three core palettes
Manual QA pass for mobile small screens to verify fluid typography behavior
Bundle analysis to ensure token changes do not materially increase shipped CSS/JS
risks: Large consumer surface area may cause regressions if aliases are missed
Legacy CSS variables used in third-party embeds may not pick up new tokens without updates
Edge cases in chart libraries where elevation/shadow interacts poorly with WebGL layers
